ETM-8837.summary: [FE][MT] Verify the Excel export of Shutdown Logic, Manpower Mob Plan and Equipment Mob Plan shows Ramp Down Date and Ramp Up Date with the Plan values

steps.action: Open the page from the table row.
steps.result: The page opens.

steps.action: Click Export and choose Excel.
steps.result: An Excel file is downloaded.

steps.action: Open the metadata part of the file and note down the sheet name and the cell range of the labels.
steps.result: The sheet and the cells are written down and the labels `Ramp Down Date` and `Ramp Up Date` are shown.

steps.action: Look for the old labels.
steps.result: The labels `Start Event Date` and `End Event Date` do not appear.

steps.action: Read the values next to the two labels.
steps.result: `Ramp Down Date` shows the Plan Ramp Down `15 Mar 2026` and `Ramp Up Date` shows the Plan Ramp Up `25 Mar 2026` (not the event Planned Date), in the same cell format as the old `Start Event Date` and `End Event Date` cells had in the current export (baseline: date only stays date only; the time `09:00` and `18:00` appears only if the current export shows time).

steps.action: For the Shutdown Logic row only, read the date of `Day1` (ETM-5492).
steps.result: `Day1` is `15 Mar 2026`, not the event Planned Date Start.

ETM-8842.summary: [FE][BE][MT] Verify Confirm on `Extend Daily Report` moves the Plan Ramp Up and the Daily Report snapshot Ramp Up together, and never the Shutdown Event Planned Date

steps.action: Freeze the last execution day of the Daily Report (ETM-4125).
steps.result: The confirmation `Extend Daily Report` appears with `Confirm` and `Cancel`.

steps.action: Click `Cancel`.
steps.result: The confirmation closes.

steps.action: Note down whether the last execution day is still frozen.
steps.result: The state is written down and used in step 5.

steps.action: Open `Edit Plan` and read the End.
steps.result: The End still shows `25 Feb 2026 18:00`.

steps.action: Close the modal.
steps.result: The modal closes.

steps.action: Freeze the last execution day again as noted in step 3 and click `Confirm`.
steps.result: The Daily Report is extended as today (no date is chosen by the user); note down by how many days.

steps.action: Write down the new last execution day of the Daily Report.
steps.result: The new last execution day is written down and is later than `25 Feb 2026`.

steps.action: Open `Edit Plan` and read the End.
steps.result: The End date equals the new last execution day from step 7 and is later than `25 Feb 2026`; Start is still `15 Feb 2026 09:00`. Note down the Ramp Up time (Dev pending: Plan and snapshot are saved both or neither).

steps.action: Read the badge of the Plan on the Planning tab.
steps.result: The badge shows the same End as the Edit Plan modal.

steps.action: Open the Daily Report and read the end of the Planned S-Curve.
steps.result: The curve ends on the new last execution day from step 7.

steps.action: Open Edit Shutdown Event and read the Planned Date.
steps.result: It is still `08 Feb 2026 08:00` - `22 Feb 2026 08:00`; the event Planned Date did not change.

steps.action: Freeze the new last execution day and click `Confirm`.
steps.result: A second extension is saved.

steps.action: Compare the Plan End in `Edit Plan` with the Daily Report last execution day.
steps.result: Both show the same date, later than the first extension.

steps.action: Open Edit Shutdown Event and read the Planned Date.
